main_body: A wooden shelf unit with scrolls, books and items on shelves, drawn as a flat front view with a light wood top frame band at rows 1-2
top_band: light tan #d6b37e rows 1-2 (2 rows), then a 1-row edge #ac7238 at row 3, then the dark interior of the shelf cavity
evidence: The column at x=16 shows only a 2-row light wood band at the top, then a thin tan row, then the shelf interior drawn face-on. The top is a 1-2px rim, and the shelf compartments are vertical faces. The shelf interior is painted as a flat front view, so no horizontal top surface reads. This is a front elevation with a thin cap, like the red 'front elevation: top 1' and 'rim only: top 2' guide shapes.

style.evidence: The candidate has 19 colours per tile against 17 and 20 for the references, 9% flat-fill coverage (below the stall's 13%), and 0% neutral dark edge pixels, so the outlines are tinted brown. Wood has several steps (light tan, orange, mid brown, dark brown), and the items carry small multi-tone detail (blue jar, red scrolls, cream scrolls). The dark maroon interior is a fairly flat fill in places, but it is broken up by shelves and objects. It sits at the level of the references.
